description.value: Yummy Sushi Gallery is a Japanese sushi restaurant in Abbotsford offering dine-in and online takeout ordering. The establishment features outdoor seating, making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: bollard (3 spaces) at 85m. Total: 3 spaces.

Takeout is confirmed from the "Order Online" text on the website.
